name: t5s_capped_dt6
description: Phase 3 T5s CAPPED SINGLE-CELL CONTROL (t5s_capped_dt6). The plan's section 5.1 item 1: t5s_neutral_pc is the zero-shear pulse cell run through the external-sounding path, and T5 section 7.5 measured that it is NOT the 'one bubble, one cell' control the classifier was designed against -- after t=70 min its cold pool rings up an axisymmetric gust-front ring of daughter cells. This run is t5s_neutral_pc with a capping inversion added and NOTHING else changed: same deck (isnd=7, iwnd=0, irandp=0, seed 0, imove=0, 180x180x40 at 999 m, timax 7200 s), so the ONLY difference between this run and t5s_neutral_pc is input_sounding_sha256. Cap: well-mixed below 600 m, +6 K inversion above it relaxing onto WK82 over 500 m. CAPE is held by CONSTRUCTION, not by the solver -- hold_cape_jkg is deliberately NOT set, because the plan measured that holding CAPE against a cooling cap makes the solver RAISE qv_pbl and saturate harder; at 600 m the cap costs 3.8 J/kg of SB CAPE unaided (1859.7 -> 1855.9), which is the hold. PRE-REGISTRATION: docs/plan-science-hurdles-2026-09-02.md section 5.2, written before either member ran.

provenance.neutrality_reference: sim/probes/configs/t5s_neutral_pc.json -- the UNCAPPED member of this pair. This is not a neutrality control; it is the single-variable comparison the cap is measured against.
provenance.brn_regime_note: BRN is infinite at zero shear -- the label is degenerate here, as for t5s_neutral_pc. This probe tests SUPPRESSION OF SECONDARY CONVECTION at fixed CAPE, not regime.
provenance.bubble_feasibility: MEASURED OFFLINE BEFORE THE RUN. CM1's warm bubble (iinit=1, init3d.F:456-479) is centred at z=1400 m with bptpert=1.0 K, so its warm core sits ABOVE this 600 m cap: on CM1's own scalar levels the bubble parcel has theta'=0.556 K at 750 m and 0.972 K at 1250 m, and CIN 0.00 J/kg from either level in BOTH cap members -- while the 250 m parcel (theta'=0.077 K) still carries -82 J/kg. Initiation is therefore NOT at risk; the cap acts on surface-based (gust-front) parcels only, which is exactly the intended separation. The 'cap too strong to initiate' failure mode is measured away before the run rather than discovered in it.
provenance.cape_hold_measured: SB CAPE 1855.9 J/kg vs the uncapped reference 1859.7 J/kg = 3.8 J/kg, with no solver. (The plan's section 5.1 claimed 'within 2 J/kg'; measured, the 6 K member is 3.8 J/kg. Recorded as measured rather than as claimed.)
provenance.z_blend_note: z_blend_m=500 m is NOT a free choice: section 5.1's CIN table records z_cap_m and dtheta_k only, and CIN depends on the blend depth. 500 m reproduces the whole 20-entry table to max |err| 0.46 J/kg (rounding); 400 m is off by 10.1 and 100 m by 39.2. Measured offline before the run.

sounding._note: WK82 reference thermodynamics: theta_0=300 K, theta_tr=343 K, T_tr=213 K, z_tr=12 km, qv_pbl=14 g/kg, p_sfc=1000 hPa (module defaults; declared explicitly for the record).

cap._note: CIN knob (sounding.apply_cap): well-mixed to theta_sfc below z_cap_m, a +dtheta_k inversion above it decaying linearly onto WK82 over z_blend_m. McCaul & Cohen (2002) knob semantics; the piecewise construction is this project's own.
